data.display_address: Mercer House, Uptown Dubai, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai
data.long_description:
Mercer House invites residents to experience the urban elegance of Uptown Dubai. Set within two stunning towers that define the skyline, Mercer House provides breathtaking views of both the vibrant cityscape and the serene Dubai coastline. The property features a range of lavish living spaces, including studios, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as opulent four-bedroom penthouses. Residents benefit from a carefully curated lifestyle and exceptional amenities, including a 45,000 sq. ft. beach club, diverse retail and shopping options, and a multi-sports complex for various athletic pursuits. Additional highlights include family and skyline pools, cutting-edge fitness studios, and indulgent spa rooms.

AMENITIES

– Urban beach club
– Retail and F&B shops
– Multi-sports hall
– Padel and squash courts
– Family and skyline pools
– Sing and dance revolution area
– Arcade-themed area
– Clubhouse
– Fitness studio
– Scenic sauna and ice room

Uptown Dubai, located next to Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT) is an ideal residential community for families and individuals who appreciate a panoramic waterfront promenade and breathtaking landscapes. Situated across from the world-class Dubai Marina, JLT offers a relaxed community feel with a range of amenities. It is home to retail outlets, offices, and a vast array of dining, shopping, recreation, and entertainment options, making it a popular spot for enjoying life’s finer pleasures.
